item.title: Biochemist Dr. Ida Stephens Owens mapped how human genes con…
item.author: Admirable Women (@admirablewomen.bsky.social)
item.description:
Biochemist Dr. Ida Stephens Owens mapped how human genes control drug metabolism.

The first Black woman to earn a PhD from Duke (1967), she spent ~50 years at NIH. She identified the UGT1A gene complex, decoding how enzymes detoxify drugs & harmful toxins. She was born #OTD in 1939.🧵

#WomenInSTEM
